stem: Which sentence best supports the idea that there was value in Baatar's search for the sponge?

options.label: A
options.text: "No, you can only find it in a distant land." (paragraph 6)

options.label: B
options.text: All he wanted was a warm place to sleep and some food in his belly. (paragraph 12)

options.label: C
options.text: Baatar had nothing to lose, so he went along. (paragraph 14)

options.label: D
options.text: "You sent me to find this thing so that I would learn what it meant to be a servant." (paragraph 26)
